acceptance_criteria.description: Client-supplied role and status each return 422 validation_failed through the real route and create no Account.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/registration-acceptance.test.ts exercises role and status separately through the Route Handler with real CSRF and PostgreSQL.
Each case compares the Account count before and after and passed in the focused and full integration runs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Two source addresses that normalize to one identity produce one active USER and a safe 409 without address or database-error leakage.
evidence: The PostgreSQL acceptance test registers a decomposed mixed-case Unicode/IDN address, retries its NFC/Punycode equivalent, observes 201 then 409 conflict, and queries exactly one active USER.
The test rejects either original address and raw 23505, duplicate-key, table and normalized-column details in the conflict response.

acceptance_criteria.description: Email normalization covers ASCII-only outer trimming, NFC and lowercase local parts, IDNA/Punycode domains, controls/internal whitespace and malformed domains.
evidence: tests/unit/identity/account-service.test.ts covers each D-50 boundary and provider-specific non-rewrites.
The malformed underscore domain is also rejected with no write through the real route/PostgreSQL test.

acceptance_criteria.description: Passwords of 12 and 128 code points are accepted, 11 and 129 are rejected, and complete valid passwords are verified without truncation.
evidence: tests/unit/identity/account-service.test.ts asserts exact 11/12/128/129 inputs through validatePassword and parseRegistrationInput.
Argon2 verification passes the full 128-code-point password and rejects a different valid 128-code-point suffix and a 129-code-point extension.
